label: noni3
title: のに
meaning_example: I wish today's weather was as nice as yesterday's

notes.text: I believe this use of noni is interchangeable with のだけれでも
notes.html: I believe this use of noni is interchangeable with のだけれでも

examples.japanese: 今日の天気が昨日のような天気だったら良かった。のに
examples.body_text:
今日の天気が昨日のような天気だったら良かった。のに 

		I wish today's weather had been as nice as yesterday's. 
		のに
examples.body_html:
今日の天気が昨日のような天気だったら良かった。のに 
I wish today's weather had been as nice as yesterday's. のに

examples.japanese: 雨さえやめばいいのになあ。
examples.body_text:
雨さえやめばいいのになあ。 

		If only it would stop raining!
examples.body_html:
雨さえやめばいいのになあ。 
If only it would stop raining!

comments.text: ziaz, re text, if you say that, it is だけれども instead of だけれでも.
comments.html: ziaz, re text, if you say that, it is だけれども instead of だけれでも.

comments.text: I feel like this should be listed as ればいいのに or at least いいのに. I would say that のに within the construction, by itself, is actually functioning within its "in spite of" sense.
